observations: 2 photos show a full-size electronic keyboard still wrapped in plastic/packaging.
Keys are visible (looks like a standard 61-key layout), but the exact model name/number is not readable.
No clear brand label is readable on the photos provided.
Seller text says “Quality London used keyboard with super sounds,” but no photo evidence of sound/testing.

claims.claim: Quality London used keyboard with super sounds
claims.evidence: Photos only show the keyboard wrapped; no brand/model text is readable and no audio/test results are shown.

risks.risk: Exact brand/model is not readable, so the price could be for a different (cheaper or more expensive) keyboard than what’s shown.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the brand/model label (usually back panel or front control panel) and the full control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used portable keyboard with unknown model (worst case vs the comparables).

risks.risk: Condition is unknown (wrapped item may still have defects; keys/speakers may not work).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, playing a few notes, and volume/speaker output (or headphone output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst case).

risks.risk: Accessories are unknown (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand, etc.).
risks.proof: Photos of everything included: charger/adapter, sustain pedal, stand, and any manuals.

risks.risk: Key count and features (pitch bend, built-in speakers, rhythms) are not verifiable from the wrapped photos.
risks.proof: A photo showing the feature buttons and display area clearly (or a video scrolling through sounds/rhythms).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a basic portable keyboard without confirmed premium features.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the brand/model label (front or back) so the exact model can be identified.
Video: power-on + playing keys + showing the display (if any) and volume working (speaker or headphone).
Photos of included items: charger/adapter, sustain pedal, and any stand/manual.
response.reason: The photos do not allow reliable identification of the keyboard model/brand or confirmation it works, so a worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct comparable range.
